# Saved discovery replay

`receipts.json` contains the 181 persisted discovery receipts from campaigns 49,
50 and 51, read without changing the production database. Search titles/snippets
are metadata, not verified requests. They are used only to test reading order.

Campaign 51's Internetimage original was separately reviewed as a standing
collaboration invitation already found in campaign 49. Maggioli's employer board
and the uCV collection illustrate unproductive reading priority. This is a
retrospective regression fixture, not an independent prospective quality test.

`campaign52.json` conserva i piani e le ricevute della successiva prova reale 52.
Serve a riprodurre quattro falsi rifiuti di query e la priorità delle directory.
I due possibili siti ufficiali nei risultati non sono opportunità confermate.
Le modifiche basate su questo file sono successive alla prova 52.
